notes_for_editor: Only one page names this lookout (Eastern U.S. Lookouts), with name, county and agency and nothing else. Two searches found no build date, design, height or fate for a Grant tower in Marshall County. Rejected leads: an 'Old Grant Firetower' geocache, which its search snippet puts at N44 07.445 W86 22.492 (Michigan, not Alabama); Fire Tower Road street listings in Grant (a street name, not evidence of a tower); and a 299.9 ft antenna structure in Grant registered to the Marshall County Emergency Telephone Service Board (a communications structure, not a lookout). The record coordinates (34.5227, -86.2382) and 'unknown' status were not checked against an independent source. The 1819 News article is statewide background only and does not describe this site. No correction proposed.
